entries.title: A refused custom API address says what DNS answered
entries.body: When Add a custom API refuses an address because its name points to a reserved address or to more than one kind of network, the form now lists each address DNS answered and what kind it is. A reserved answer often comes from a proxy app or a DNS filter. You can make an exception for that one address, and the connection then shows Address exception. Without the exception, the address stays refused.

picture.alt: The custom API form lists 198.18.0.42 as reserved and a public IPv6 address, with an unticked choice to make an exception for that address
